candidates.reason: A real banner rearrangement that reads left to right (logo, bottle, headline, subcopy plus CTA) and keeps the brand and hierarchy. Flaws: the logo is oversized and competes with the bottle, and the bottle sits half off the card and crowds the logo. The legal text is squeezed into a narrow 4-line column at an unreadable size. The right column is cramped while the headline block has slack.

The CTA button hangs off the card's right edge and nearly touches the canvas edge. The headline runs straight into the button with no gutter. The logo has shrunk to a tiny dot at the bottom and the brand is lost. The legal line is set almost as large as the subcopy, which flattens the hierarchy. There is dead space under the headline row.

Same structure as candidate 2, with slightly more room around the CTA. Still broken: the headline almost touches the button, and the logo is a tiny bottom-left mark that loses the brand. The legal text is as prominent as the subcopy. The subcopy and legal lines are centred, which clashes with the left-placed logo, so nothing shares an edge.

The original portrait layout has been shrunk into the centre of a wide canvas instead of rearranged. The headline, subcopy, CTA and legal text are microscopic and unreadable, and the logo is a speck. About 90% of the banner is busy confetti with no message. This is unusable.
